# Product requirements

## 1. Conventions

Requirement ids are `<CODE>-F-nnn` and `<CODE>-N-nnn`; a withdrawn requirement keeps its id.
Decisions are in [founder-decisions.md](../founder-decisions.md).

## 2. Codes

| Code | Area | PRD | Milestones |
|---|---|---|---|
| LND | Lending | [01-lending.md](01-lending.md) | M1, M2 |
| MEM | Members | [02-members.md](02-members.md) | M1 |
| NTF | Notifications | [02-members.md](02-members.md) | M1, M2 |
| PLT | Platform | [03-platform.md](03-platform.md) | M0, M1, M2 |

## 3. Milestones

| Milestone | Contents |
|---|---|
| M0 | Foundations: the workspace and the gates |
